title: Step 69-E Bulk pricing scope preview status review and apply administration
description: Implement the HIGH-risk AD-D-03 Admin bulk-pricing workflow on top of canonical Step69-D: source-proven scope/change preview, bounded affected-item review, authoritative operation status read, explicit Action Review + WebAuthn Step-Up, scoped Idempotency-Key apply, and fail-closed recovery that only permits explicit same-key/same-payload replay after status check. Do not invent requester binding, fresh guard guarantees, generic operation lists, FX/Excel authority, Backend/OpenAPI/database changes, Step70 scope, production FX provider work, or Graph/Graphify.

dependencies.evidence: PR #373 exact artifact 1d65c625d84fb63862706806c0d9d8f407b50b8197278fae150673ed2b1c3da5 merged after exact-head CI/Phase A/CodeQL/Review/Security/Lock/Human Gate; exact-SHA Canonical CI #2081, Phase A #1580 and CodeQL #1232 succeeded; terminal Lock release comment 6309500326.

evidence.recovery: Unknown apply outcome must first use GET operation status. The Idempotency-Key is deterministically derived server-side from preview_id, is never browser authority, and explicit replay is allowed only with the unchanged apply payload after authoritative status confirms the operation is still previewed and unexpired.

acceptance_criteria.description: AD-D-03 uses only the three canonical bulk-pricing operations and never invents an operation list, audit endpoint or extra lifecycle.
Preview validates bounded scope/change input, retains Backend as authority for the 5000-variant cap, shows affected_count separately from the at-most-200 visible items and discloses truncation.
Apply uses existing Admin server auth bridge, WebAuthn Step-Up, exact reviewed expected_affected_count and a scoped Idempotency-Key; no Step-Up token is rendered or stored in browser state.

Unknown apply outcomes are never automatically replayed. Recovery reads authoritative operation status and only offers explicit replay when status remains previewed and unexpired; the same Idempotency-Key is deterministically re-derived server-side from preview_id and cannot be replaced by browser input.
Expired, affected-count drift, current-price drift, stored profit-guard failure, Step-Up failure, denied, invalid and unavailable states fail closed while preserving safe review context where useful.
UI never claims requester binding, a fresh profit-guard recheck at apply, complete visibility beyond returned preview items, or automatic safety beyond source-proven Backend checks.
Persian RTL workflow is keyboard reachable, uses explicit review/cancel-first focus, prevents double submission, exposes request IDs and supports responsive item review.
No FX, Excel, Backend/OpenAPI/generated-contract/database/Storefront/Current-State/Product-Design/Inventory/Procurement/POS/production-FX-provider/Graph mutation is introduced.

Canonical closure requires exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A and CodeQL, deterministic Review, independent Security PASS, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock, Project Owner Human Gate, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Step 69-E is HIGH risk. Exact-artifact Project Owner Human Gate is mandatory after technical/security/review/Lock evidence. Step 69-F remains blocked until terminal 69-E canonical closure.
